wizard.title: Create a LinkedIn campaign
wizard.description: Choose senders, add leads, write the sequence and preview it with real lead data. It stays paused until you launch it.
wizard.setupDescription: Choose a clear name and the LinkedIn accounts that can send.
wizard.typeRegularHint: Visible in Messages and shared with AgentSDR.
wizard.typePersonalHint: Kept out of the shared Messages workspace.
wizard.noAccountsWarning: Connect a LinkedIn account before launching. You can still save this campaign paused.
wizard.leadsDescription: Import a spreadsheet and review its column mapping, or select people already in your database.

wizard.peopleBody: Select existing people who already have a LinkedIn profile.
